disclaimer: Reference summary for planning — verify against flag, class, and latest IMO/port notices before operation.

ecaRegions.name: Baltic Sea ECA
ecaRegions.regulation: MARPOL Annex VI — Baltic Sea SOx ECA (SECA) and NOx Tier III ECAs for new builds in designated areas.
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m (1 January 2015); global cap 0.50% outside ECA.
ecaRegions.noxNote: Tier III applies to new marine diesel engines installed on ships constructed on/after applicable dates in Baltic NOx ECAs.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: Complete change-over before entry; log start/end positions, times, ROB of each grade, and purging of service tanks/manifolds. Allow settling and line flushing — typical planning buffer 30–60 nm or 4–8 hours sea time depending on tank layout.

ecaRegions.name: North Sea ECA
ecaRegions.regulation: MARPOL Annex VI — North Sea SOx ECA (includes English Channel approaches).
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m in ECA; verify UK/EU reception facilities for scrubber residues when alongside.
ecaRegions.noxNote: North Sea NOx ECA — Tier III for qualifying new installations per engine category dates.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: Plan switch at least one consumption cycle before ECA boundary; record FONAR only when truly unforeseeable — PSC trend is strict on incomplete logs.

ecaRegions.name: North American ECA
ecaRegions.regulation: MARPOL Annex VI — US/Canada coordinated ECA (200 nm from baseline, with exceptions).
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m; US EPA/CG verify scrubber compliance and monitoring records.
ecaRegions.noxNote: Tier III NOx standards for applicable new engines in North American ECAs.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: USCG PSC focus: change-over log aligned with ECDIS track, BDN sulphur %, and segregated low-sulphur service tank soundings.

ecaRegions.name: US Caribbean ECA
ecaRegions.regulation: MARPOL Annex VI — Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands ECA.
ecaRegions.noxNote: Tier III where applicable for new engines in Caribbean ECA.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: Coordinate with USCG AMVER/ECA entry when routing via Mona Passage — allow extra time for purging if single HFO service tank.

ecaRegions.name: Mediterranean Sea ECA (IMO 0.10% S)
ecaRegions.regulation: MARPOL Annex VI — Mediterranean Sea SOx ECA in force 1 May 2025 (MEPC.359(79)).
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m throughout Mediterranean SOx ECA unless equivalent arrangement (e.g. closed-loop scrubber) approved.
ecaRegions.noxNote: NOx Tier III not designated for entire Med by default — confirm for specific port/flag combinations.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: 2025 compliance focus: pre-load LSMGO/MGO with verified sulphur ≤0.10% at Gibraltar, Suez, or prior bunkering hub; keep BDN and sampling chain intact for Paris MoU.

ecaRegions.name: China Coastal DECA (0.10% S zone)
ecaRegions.regulation: PRC Ministry of Transport — domestic emission control areas (DECA) at 0.50% then 0.10% m/m sulphur in designated coastal waters.
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m in core DECA waters (verify latest MOT circular for exact coordinates and inland river extensions).
ecaRegions.noxNote: Local NOx/reporting rules may apply in key ports — check agent for Yangtze/Pearl River deltas.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: Agent briefing mandatory: many terminals require pre-arrival fuel change declaration; keep HFO heating off low-sulphur lines to avoid contamination.

ecaRegions.name: Korea Coastal ECA (designated port waters)
ecaRegions.regulation: Republic of Korea — designated sulphur control areas at major ports (Busan, Ulsan, Yeosu/Gwangyang, Incheon, Pyeongtaek) per MOF/MOLIT guidance.
ecaRegions.sulphurLimit: 0.10% m/m in designated port control areas; align with Korean ECA implementation schedules.
ecaRegions.noxNote: Port-specific environmental inspections may include scrubber washwater and BWMS records.
ecaRegions.fuelChangeoverSop: Enter port limits on compliant fuel; Korean PSC checks change-over logbook, oil record book cross-references, and sample labels.
